facts.statement: Araripesaurus is a pterosaur belonging to the suborder Pterodactyloidea.
facts.quote: Araripesaurus is a potentially dubious genus a pterosaur belonging to the suborder Pterodactyloidea

facts.statement: Araripesaurus was discovered in the Romualdo Formation of the Santana Group in northeastern Brazil.
facts.quote: it was discovered in the Romualdo Formation of the Santana Group in northeastern Brazil

facts.statement: Araripesaurus lived during the Aptian and Albian stages of the Early Cretaceous.
facts.quote: which dates back to the Aptian and Albian of the Early Cretaceous

facts.statement: The genus Araripesaurus was named in 1971 by the Brazilian paleontologist Llewellyn Ivor Price.
facts.quote: The genus was named in 1971 by Brazilian paleontologist Llewellyn Ivor Price

facts.statement: The genus name Araripesaurus refers to the Araripe Plateau.
facts.quote: The genus name refers to the Araripe Plateau

facts.statement: The specific name castilhoi honors collector Moacir Marques de Castilho, who donated the fossil-bearing nodule in 1966.
facts.quote: The specific name honors the collector Moacir Marques de Castilho, who in 1966 donated the chalk nodule containing the fossil

facts.statement: The holotype specimen consists of a partial wing including distal radius and ulna fragments, carpals, all metacarpals, and several digits.
facts.quote: The holotype, DNPM (DGM 529-R), consists of a partial wing, including distal fragments of the radius and ulna, carpals, all metacarpals and several digits

facts.statement: The holotype was a subadult with an estimated wingspan of 2.2 meters.
facts.quote: The specimen was a subadult. Its wingspan was estimated at 2.2 m

facts.statement: Two other known specimens consist of wing fragments that are roughly one-third larger than the holotype.
facts.quote: Two other possible specimens are known; both consist of wing fragments and are roughly a third larger than the holotype

facts.statement: Peter Wellnhofer named a second species, Araripesaurus santanae, in 1985.
facts.quote: In 1985 Peter Wellnhofer has named a second species, Araripesaurus santanae

facts.statement: In 1990, Alexander Kellner moved Araripesaurus santanae to the genus Anhanguera.
facts.quote: In 1990 by Kellner moved to Anhanguera as A. santanae

facts.statement: Llewellyn Ivor Price originally classified Araripesaurus in the family Ornithocheiridae.
facts.quote: Price placed Araripesaurus in the Ornithocheiridae

facts.statement: In 1991, Alexander Kellner concluded that Araripesaurus was identical to the genus Santanadactylus.
facts.quote: In 1991 researcher Alexander Kellner concluded that Araripesaurus was identical to Santanadactylus

facts.statement: In 2000, Alexander Kellner reassessed the genus and concluded it could not be synonymized with Santanadactylus due to a lack of unique characters.
facts.quote: In 2000 Kellner reassessed the genus and concluded that precisely because of such a lack of autapomorphies (unique characters), it could not be synonymized with Santanadactylus

facts.statement: Alexander Kellner noted that Araripesaurus resembled Anhanguera piscator in morphology but was considerably smaller.
facts.quote: Kellner also indicated that Araripesaurus resembled Anhanguera piscator in morphology, albeit considerably smaller

facts.statement: A 2025 review by Pinheiro et al. suggested Araripesaurus is a nomen dubium because the specimens are insufficient for a valid diagnosis.
facts.quote: In a comprehensive review of the taxonomy and paleobiology of Cretaceous pterosaurs from the Araripe Basin by Pinheiro et al. (2025), Araripesaurus was suggested to be a nomen dubium due to the specimens being insufficient for a valid diagnosis

facts.statement: Araripesaurus is a pterosaur genus belonging to the suborder Pterodactyloidea from the Santana Formation of Brazil.
facts.quote: Araripesaurus es un género de pterosaurio, perteneciente al suborden Pterodactyloidea, de la conocida formación Santana de Brasil

facts.statement: The genus name refers to the Araripe Plateau.
facts.quote: El nombre del género se refiere a la meseta de Araripe

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a partial wing including distal radius and ulna fragments, carpals, all metacarpals, and several digits.
facts.quote: El holotipo, DNPM (DGM 529-R), consiste de un ala parcial, incluyendo fragmentos distales del radio y el cúbito, carpos, todos los metacarpos y varios dígitos

facts.statement: The wingspan of the holotype has been estimated at 2.2 meters.
facts.quote: Su envergadura alar se ha estimado en 2.2 metros

facts.statement: In 2000, Kellner reevaluated the genus and concluded it could not be synonymized with Santanadactylus due to the lack of unique characters.
facts.quote: En 2000 Kellner revaluó el género y concluyó que precisamente la carencia de dichas autapomorfias (características únicas), no podía ser sinonimizado con Santanadactylus

facts.statement: Kellner classified Araripesaurus as close to Anhangueridae and more derived than Istiodactylus based on cladistic analysis.
facts.quote: le dio una clasificación con un análisis cladístico como cercano a los Anhangueridae, y más derivado que Istiodactylus
